dedupe_keys.name: chad list of health facilities and health districts ministry of public health

description: This data set gives Chad's official list of health facilities, from hospitals to health centres, with the country's health districts and health provinces as map layers. The producer is Chad's Ministry of Public Health; OCHA Chad compiled and published it on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. Coverage is national. It includes a spreadsheet of facilities by health district, a point shapefile of facilities, and polygon shapefiles of health districts and health provinces, in versions dated 2020. The files are available as free downloads under a Creative Commons Attribution licence. Caveats: according to the provider, the list was assembled from the ministry's health statistics yearbooks of 2012 and 2013, a 2016 directive fixing the official districts, and the national malaria programme's facility list, so it is dated; capacities and services are not given. Simulation uses: a facility and health district layer for hazard exposure and access modelling, assigning population to districts for service planning, and a reference for humanitarian health operations. Related records: healthsites.io (data-healthsites-io) and the HeiGIT accessibility indicators (data-heigit-accessibility-indicators) cover Chad from open data.
